activation: Create with the host scheduler after explicit user authorization; never auto-enable on package installation.
notification: Send one concise brief for useful independent findings, newly retained conditional candidates, changed judgments or required decisions, even when adoption is deferred. Deduplicate unchanged candidates; keep duplicate-only/no-value runs quiet. Follow proactive/reporting.md; deliver the requested joint review once.
knowledge: Only after the recipient explicitly authorizes automatic ingestion; follow the installed Knowledge contract and exact final-report approval. Package installation grants no ingestion authority.

review.change_sources_or_frequency: Requires user decision after evidence-based review

cadence_control.schedule_changes: Propose with evidence and reason; apply only after explicit user approval. No automatic changes.

missed_runs.host_requirements: Local computer powered on and desktop app running
missed_runs.host_catch_up: Not established; do not assume automatic missed-trigger recovery
missed_runs.research_recovery: Next actual run covers since last successful coverage checkpoint within the current budget; merge gaps without bursting multiple runs
missed_runs.count: Only actual completed scheduled runs count; missing triggers do not count

model_selection.activation: Only after explicit recipient authorization for the host scope; package installation grants no autonomous model-use authority.
model_selection.fallback: Original Research path; retain complete sources and IDs.
model_selection.review_window: Existing host window; default joint review after four actual scheduled runs per route; no new schedule.
